info.title: API.SH: Redbubble
info.description: The Redbubble API from API.SH: public Redbubble data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An artist's shop: name, bio, location, avatar, banner, badges and collections, and their products by department, collection and sort (newest or best selling), with the total. 100 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/redbubble-artist

parameters.name: collection_id
parameters.description: One of the artist's collections (ids in the response).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product (a design on one product type): title, description, tags, price, discount and volume discounts, every colour/size/print-location variant with its price and stock, product features, all images, the department, the artist (name, profile, featured status, external links), promotions, related searches, and every other product the design is sold on with its price.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/redbubble-product

get.description:
Designs for sale on every product Redbubble prints (t-shirts, stickers, posters, phone cases, mugs...), filtered by department, price band, artwork medium and mature content, sorted by relevance, trending, newest or best selling: product, price and discount, volume discounts, size, image, artist and the design's tags, with the total, related searches and the filters that apply. About 80 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/redbubble-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Optional when category is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Department code (u-tees, all-stickers, u-phone-cases ...; see /redbubble/v1/categories). Default all-departments.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Price bands, comma-separated: low, medium, high.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/redbubble-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id from search or product results.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
